The survivors of @place-saltmere sang this in the old tongue at the first gathering after the fall:

*Şafakta İlsa'nın ışığı söndü,*
*tuz kuleler yandı, çöl sustu.*

("At dawn the light of Ilsa went out; the salt towers burned, the desert fell silent.")

Some say [[char-kadir|Kadir]] carried the song from caravan to caravan so that no one would forget **the white city**.
